Type: stoneware lantern candle holders, set of two
Use: holding pillar candles; on a table, shelf or mantel; living room, dining room
Style: rustic, farmhouse, coastal
Materials: glazed stoneware, raw clay rim and base, braided macrame rope handle
Colors: cream white with speckles, warm clay, natural rope
Shape: cylindrical jar body with rows of rectangular cutouts, open top, rope carry handle, compact
Feel: warm, relaxed, cozy
Goes with: natural wood, linen, white walls, sandy tones; farmhouse, coastal or bohemian rooms

product.description: These 2 stoneware lanterns boast an elegant reactive glaze with flecks of blue. Light from a votive candle can shine through the rectangular cutouts, and the handles provide easy transport. 6.57" Diameter x 10.04"H; 6.55" Diameter x 8.25"H 100% stoneware Can be used with candles or on their own
